source_analysis.skill: Determine an axis intercept of a tangent or normal to an implicitly defined curve.
reasoning_steps: Apply chain and, for xy, product rules with y=y(x).
Solve for dy/dx and evaluate at the supplied on-curve point.
For a normal use -1/m, otherwise retain m.
Form y-y0=s(x-x0); set y=0 for x intercept or x=0 for y intercept.
Report both coordinates in a radio pair or two exact-entry blanks.
invariants: Point lies on curve; curve regular at point.
Requested line has a unique finite axis intersection.
Every derivative, reciprocal, and intercept step appears in solution.
No requirement that point signs, line type, target axis, intercept sign or choice position remain fixed.
Every band retains implicit differentiation, slope evaluation, line construction, and intercept determination without added procedural hints.
permitted_variations: Small integer/rational coefficients, translated quadratic terms, xy product terms, ellipse/hyperbola/parabola forms supported by source.
Tangent versus normal, x versus y target, reflected point signs and zero intercepts where intersection remains unique.
Easy may use simple tangent arithmetic while retaining differentiation and intercept completion; moderate increases implicit algebra; hard can require reciprocal and product-rule combination.
